goal: Prevent wallet rebroadcasts from leaking node IP addresses when private broadcast is enabled
Route periodic rebroadcasts through anonymized connections instead of public broadcast
reviewability: Author silent for 159 days; reviews may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Support for routing wallet rebroadcasts through the private broadcast mechanism (pablomartin4btc, w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: attacker can send dust to force public rebroadcasts unless IsMine is handled (mzumsande)
Answered objection: private broadcast to random peers delays dependent transactions like CPFP (achow101)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because periodic rebroadcasts bypass private broadcast and leak node IP addresses
It fixes a critical privacy break for users relying on anonymized origin connections

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because the wallet resubmission logic exposes user IP addresses on public broadcast
It resolves a serious privacy defect for wallet users configuring private broadcast
